 Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely anchored on the user’s hypothesis that erosion/dissection is the “most likely” mechanism, and directed the search to confirm it rather than neutrally evaluating all options and the wording of the choices. This confirmation bias misinterpreted erosion (which primarily modifies/dissects plateaus) as a formative process and steered the workflow away from the correct mechanism among the options—widespread lava flows building volcanic plateaus (D).
